The passage features complex, luminous crystalline forms that drift and distort within the flowing space. A foundational bioluminescence permeates the scene, pulsing rhythmically in shifting waves. As the flow continues, these pulsing lights cast ephemeral, visible diffraction patterns across the molecular crystals, giving the sense of constantly passing, ethereal light interference. The entire environment is a continuous, dynamic spectacle of light and abstract geometry.
